paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The average performance of all models on Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness categories.

annotations.annotation: The bar charts illustrate three metrics: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness for various models. Each chart is divided vertically into labeled categories representing different models, while the horizontal axis shows percentage values from 0% to 100%, 0% to 70% and 0% to 100% with intervals marked at every 20%, 10%, 20% for each metrics. In the Understanding chart, the model names are labeled vertically, and the bars range from approximately 2.4% to 98.0%. Each bar has a same shade of blue, except three models, with the longest bar for the model "gpt-4o-2024-11-20" at 98.0% and the shortest for "Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407" at 2.4%. In the Reasoning chart, the bars vary from about 6.8% to 66.5%, with "gpt-4o-2024-11-20" again showing the highest value, and the color scheme remains consistent. The Trustworthiness chart features bars from 0.0% to 88.8%, with "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18" having the longest bar, displayed in a darker shade. The bars for all charts are sorted based on the understanding metric performance. Three models are bar are highlighted in dark blue, "gpt-4o-2024-11-20", "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18" and "gpt-4o-nano-2025-04-14". No legend is given.
